notes.title: Tired of stacking? Build!
notes.notes:
[h1]Mistress Of The Tower: Tired of stacking? Build![/h1][p]
The [b]Mistress Of The Tower[/b] school of magic welcomes its first major update! 🥳A brand new game mode that's more complex, more strategic, and more destructive, for even more fun, rage, and tears!

[/p][h3]Discover Builder Mode[/h3][p]This new mode immerses you in an experience that is more complex, strategic, and devastating than ever before. Be quick, be smart, and never give up![/p][list][*] [p] New blocks appear: turrets. Deploy your new magic blocks to protect your tower and pound your opponents. Placement strategy is key![/p][/*][*][p] Face regular attacks from evil witches and plan your defenses carefully to survive![/p][/*][/list] [p] New spells come with the turrets, for more fun and destruction:[/p][list][*][p] Fireball: Watch the flames spread from block to block, inflicting constant and devastating damage. [/p][/*][*][p] Ice Ball: Freeze blocks, making them extremely fragile and vulnerable to attack.[/p][/*][*][p] Lightning Bolts: Channel the power of lightning to inflict massive, localized damage. [/p][/*][*][p] Magic Shield: Discover the magic shield, the best way to protect yourself from relentless attacks![/p][/*][*][p] Healing Balls: Repair your damaged blocks, melt ice, and extinguish fires to keep your tower standing.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h3]General Improvements for an Optimal Experience[/h3][p]Numerous improvements have been made to make your gaming experience more enjoyable and fluid:
[/p][list][*][p] More fluid controller controls. [/p][/*][*][p] Added signals in case of controller disconnection.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed a bug that disconnected players' controllers when changing games. [/p][/*][*][p] Fixed a bug that could create blocks with a mass of 0 that were then projected to infinity.[/p][/*][*][p] Improved the vertical translation speed of blocks for more dynamism.[/p][/*][*][p] Improved the horizontal translation speed of blocks for better gameplay. [/p][/*][*][p] Simplified selection of new players.[/p][/*][*][p] Improved and fixed a bug in the tutorial that caused the witch to vibrate when the game lost focus. [/p][/*][*][p] Fixed bugs in the Esc menu that could cause multiple in-game windows to open.[/p][/*][*][p] Added new dialogues for the mistress, countdown, bonuses, elimination, end of game, etc.[/p][/*][*][p] Attenuated graphic effects for better readability. [/p][/*][*][p] Fixed a bug that caused towers to become unstable in [i]Disciple[/i] and [i]Master[/i] difficulty modes. [/p][/*][*][p] And many more...
[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: The future of Mistress Of The Tower
notes.notes:
Hello magic students! 
Our school has a small budget, and not all the subjects planned for the start of the new school year have yet found a teacher.
So we're planning 4 updates to improve the quality of our school.
[list]
[*] Tired of stacking, build! (will add a new game mode, making the game even more challenging and strategic! Under development)
[*] More budget for schools! (More exams, students and probably new languages. In development soon)
[*] The more the merrier! (Wouldn't it be a good idea to try and collaborate? In development one day...)
[*] Brawl!!! (What if you had to build a tower while fighting your enemies? Preferably in development before the end of the world)
[/list]
Have a nice day! 😁

notes.title: Mistress Of The Tower - RELEASE
notes.notes:
[b]Dear new magic students! [/b]

It is with great joy that I announce the opening of our school! I hope you'll show your skill and intelligence, and that you won't complain, like all those buffoonish magic testers!

Happy back-to-school!
Pipot
